Delicious Dark Chocolate Sauce
By: Jazmeen
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 12:22am

Ingredients




4 tablespoons heaped  of cacao powder
3 tablespoons of agave nectar
1 teaspoon of  raw organic coconut oil

Preparation

1 Mix all the ingredients together to form a paste. If you need it runnier, add more 2 Agave. If you need it a touch creamier, add some more raw organic coconut oil

About


simply loving the Wow now cacao experience!!!
no hesitation on eating raw chocolate, it's healthy and helps you stay lean and clean.
I read about cacao and posted some information on my blog, if you'd like to see visit: http://blog.organicbeautyfood.com/2009/07/26/raw-cacao-news.aspx
My best wishes to you all, cheers to your health!
JAZ  -  Coconut Girl
